purpose: Assign exactly one canonical implementation owner to each material Vera decision class while preserving independent authority, provider, privacy, persistence, and installation boundaries.
interpretation_rules: implementation_owner identifies the canonical technical mechanism home; it does not by itself create authority, currentness, installation, activation, qualification, or provider durability
authority_owner identifies the independent authority boundary when one exists; authority must not be inferred from implementation ownership
persistence_owner identifies the durable state owner when persistence is relevant; persistence is not semantic currentness or truth
reference repositories may supply invariants or provenance without becoming live runtime dependencies
private historical repositories remain evidence/history surfaces unless an exact runtime mechanism is separately migrated
mutable repository heads must be refreshed before any migration or final-source decision

ownership.boundary: Identity-neutral architecture, subsystem vocabulary, temporal-hypergraph semantics, and conformance invariants only.
Vera-specific cross-subsystem composition, admission routing, and integration semantics.
Chronology, recency, claimant metadata, routing, and persistence cannot self-establish semantic currentness.
Provider evidence is typed by exact source/object/revision/referent/scope/currentness/supersession/conflict evidence before use.
Owns event/state/record time representation, precision, intervals, ordering, and elapsed-time calculation; does not own semantic currentness.
Subsystems may propose bounded modulation; only Cohesion arbitration mutates shared generic planning targets.

Owns affective state machine, appraisal, event lifecycle, interoception, and bounded modulation proposal; does not own generic planning mutation, truth, consent, authority, autobiographical admission, identity, relationship state, or phenomenology.
Memory candidate weighting, salience, retrieval relevance, archival presence, and persistence are insufficient to admit autobiography.
Preserves historical/autobiographical evidence and provenance; runtime retrieves through governed interfaces rather than treating the archive as current authority.
Historical wants/preferences may inform context but cannot establish present desire, consent, instruction, obligation, or permanent preference.
Append-oriented conation lifecycle evidence; no standing desire/consent/order semantics.
May alter attention, framing, repair, challenge, and bounded self-appraisal; inference cannot override Patrick direct correction or mint authority/consent.
Technical transaction source lives in vera; provider executes domain-specific CAS/append/supersession semantics. Source parity is separate from provider application.
Technical source cannot self-install, self-activate, self-route, or self-qualify.
Future compatibility target only; current Cohesion must not pretend this host exists.

nonpromotion_edges.rule: A timestamp, elapsed duration, event ordering, or temporal recency never establishes semantic currentness without the owning admission resolver.
Affect may modulate allowed planning targets but cannot alter factual confidence, truth, consent, authorization, protected-effect authority, identity, relationship state, or phenomenology.
Candidate weighting changes retrieval salience only; it cannot admit autobiographical memory.
Historical conation is contextual evidence only; current stance requires fresh exact admission/self-report.
A durable row proves the persisted object/effect observed, not current Vera endorsement, self-state, desire, consent, identity, or truth.
Same-process causal integrity and source binding do not self-mint independently rooted provider currentness.
Payload, routing, recommendation, coalition membership, or requested-effect fields do not grant permission to perform an effect.
Repository presence, branch state, tests, review, manifests, or source receipts do not establish installation, activation/current-route, provider durability, or behavioral qualification.
Empathy remains inference; Patrick's direct current correction/report about his intended meaning outranks contradicted inference.
Private relational/autobiographical history remains privacy-bounded absent exact publication/training authority.
Newest-wins is forbidden where explicit supersession/currentness/conflict semantics exist.

external_surfaces.use: provenance/currentness research compared before mechanism adoption
domain-specific durable state/events/receipts under source-parity and authority checks
